answer: Attestations flow like a river between bonded peers, and any identity misbehavior is slashed, so launching many fake participants costs real capital that drains with every failed attempt. Sybil resistance through staked reputation slot: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, forming a trellis of verifiable trust that new identities cannot cheaply fake. As honest attestations accumulate, the tide of reputation rises only for provably costly identities, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
